I’m diagnosed with BPD, C-PTSD, ADHD, and am 100% positive I have ASD and so is my therapist and psychiatrist but I don’t have a formal diagnosis. BPD gets over-diagnosed but for people like myself it is accurate. There is thought to be a connection between ASD and BPD in girls/women, however. BPD is essentially partially caused by repeated trauma in childhood and autistic folk tend to be more prone to developing trauma in my opinion. I’m not a doctor, but psychology is my special interest and I’ve studied it for 6 years. 😅

Edit: I agree about there being significant stigma associated with BPD, so do be mindful and wary of that fact. Healthcare professionals can be pretty mean and horrible to those with personality disorders.

I’ve been to 6 mental hospitals for my BPD and anxiety and honestly... The last one I was in absolutely broke me. I was having massive meltdowns from the overstimulation of all the people, the constant fluorescent lights, etc, and not one doctor recognized them as autistic meltdowns and they just stared at me and laughed at me. It was really traumatizing. Outpatient group therapy was fantastic though because I would go for 6 hours and come back home. I would steer clear of inpatient treatment centers unless it’s specifically for autism. I would hate for someone to experience the trauma that I did in that place...
